## How much of this difference is signal?

With n = 698 test days, an accuracy or directional accuracy is only known to about ±3.7 percentage points (95%, binomial). Differences smaller than that are indistinguishable from noise. 
**No framework model has results yet, so no comparison against the baselines is possible.** Only the baselines above are real results.


The expected outcome for next-day index returns from price-derived features is small or no out-of-sample skill, so a result close to the baselines is a legitimate finding, not a failure of the pipeline.


## Model comparison on the five criteria

*Efficacy* and *prediction performance* are measured (test metrics, rank among evaluated models of the same task, baselines included; 1 = best). *Training time* is measured wall-clock on the machine that ran `run_models.py`. *Simplicity* is shown as lines of code in the model module (objective proxy) plus an analyst rating; *transparency* is an analyst rating (1 = poor, 5 = excellent) - see docs/METHODOLOGY_PART2.md for the rubric.
